reasons.persona_fit: Directly targets the owner-operator in Bareni's calm, pragmatic tone with a clear decision rule and no sales CTA, precisely respecting all persona boundaries.
reasons.clarity: The argument flows logically from the core design constraint thesis to practical diagnostic questions and an unambiguous concluding rule.
reasons.actionability: Provides a highly concrete, feasible 3-point checklist for owners to test if their workflow is ready before investing in automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately frames Bareni's demos as self-built prototypes using synthetic data with mandatory human approval, avoiding any customer claims.
